title: Fences

blocks.html: Fences, where provided, shall be considered permitted obstructions within any of the connections or open spaces required by Section 134-40 (REQUIREMENTS FOR CONNECTIONS AND OPEN AREAS), inclusive, provided they comply with the requirements of this Section:
blocks.plainText: Fences, where provided, shall be considered permitted obstructions within any of the connections or open spaces required by Section 134-40 (REQUIREMENTS FOR CONNECTIONS AND OPEN AREAS), inclusive, provided they comply with the requirements of this Section:

blocks.html: (a)        no fence shall be permitted within any clear circulation path required by Section 134-40, inclusive;
blocks.plainText: (a) no fence shall be permitted within any clear circulation path required by Section 134-40, inclusive;

blocks.html: (b)        within any required connection or open space, fences shall only be permitted:
blocks.plainText: (b) within any required connection or open space, fences shall only be permitted:

blocks.html: (1)        at the perimeter of recreation spaces, such as any playgrounds, tot lots, or dog runs, provided within such connection of open space; and
blocks.plainText: (1) at the perimeter of recreation spaces, such as any playgrounds, tot lots, or dog runs, provided within such connection of open space; and

blocks.html: (2)        along the boundary of an adjoining open commercial use or other private area;
blocks.plainText: (2) along the boundary of an adjoining open commercial use or other private area;

blocks.html: (c)        a fence shall have a maximum height of four feet measured from the adjoining grade level, and must be at least 70 percent open; and
blocks.plainText: (c) a fence shall have a maximum height of four feet measured from the adjoining grade level, and must be at least 70 percent open; and

blocks.html: (d)        chain link fencing or barbed or razor wire fencing shall not be permitted.
blocks.plainText: (d) chain link fencing or barbed or razor wire fencing shall not be permitted.

blocks.html: The City Planning Commission may authorize modification of provisions of paragraphs (a) and (b) of this Section, upon a finding that such modification is necessary to facilitate site safety and operations, and does not adversely impact access to the required connection or open s[pace during operable hours. Fences which are permitted pursuant to this authorization may rise to a maximum height of five feet measured from the adjoining grade.
blocks.plainText: The City Planning Commission may authorize modification of provisions of paragraphs (a) and (b) of this Section, upon a finding that such modification is necessary to facilitate site safety and operations, and does not adversely impact access to the required connection or open s[pace during operable hours. Fences which are permitted pursuant to this authorization may rise to a maximum height of five feet measured from the adjoining grade.

blocks.html: Any application to authorize modification of the provisions of paragraphs (a) and (b) of this Section shall be referred to the local Community Board. The Commission shall not grant such authorization prior to forty-five (45) days following the referral.
blocks.plainText: Any application to authorize modification of the provisions of paragraphs (a) and (b) of this Section shall be referred to the local Community Board. The Commission shall not grant such authorization prior to forty-five (45) days following the referral.
